title: Shattering Argentinian Skirtly Steak Empanadas
description: Quick-fix earthy empanadas featuring coconut cream and skirtly steak. A perfect weeknight dinner for meat lovers.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: chilled and cut into small pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and pepper.
Add cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour mixture.
Gradually add 1/4 cup of ice water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times until smooth.
Divide the dough into 6-8 equal pieces and roll each one into a ball.
Use a rolling pin to flatten each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of the skirtly steak mixture onto one half of the dough circle, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle a pinch of grated cheese over the top of the filling.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Use a fork to crimp the edges and create a decorative border.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the tops with beaten eggs for a golden glaze.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the empanadas are golden brown and the filling is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
